note: Declarations removed by the routine layer (PR 154) that had no entry, so that old explorer links redirect (N12). Implementations (fooImpl) are routines (fooRoutine); block relations (fooRel and its generated field lemmas) are stated by routine specifications (fooSpec); operand-form statements (foo_spec, foo_writes, writes_foo, wp_foo, runs_foo, stored_foo_wp) are carried by the one judgment fooRoutine_meets; operand structures (FooOperands) by the routine interface. Hand-written problems and their geometry lemmas (RawProblem, StoredProblem, PackedProblem, initial_*, input_buffers, length_input) are replaced by typed inputs (Ops.Inputs, a family's Certification.inputs); context snapshots and guards by isolated data operands (Mem.Isolated, Routine.withData). For an entry marked removed whose rule is typed-inputs, isolated-data, routine-interface, certificate, intro-tactic or proof-step, no declaration restates the old one: the target is the construction that replaced it.
